Software release briefing: Redaxa version 0.6.36 is now available.

Developed by AurelioAvila, the 33 MB freemium tool helps scan text for potential credentials, personal data, and financial information before sending prompts to AI systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, and Perplexity.
